home.beyondsolo.notify.owned.studio.body: The Studio at the top of the tower is yours: a bed to rest in, a kitchenette and room for your things. Go home from anywhere through the HOME page.
home.beyondsolo.notify.owned.family.body: The west wing is yours: a kitchen and dining room, a room for your mother, and a study with a desk for the Association's business.
home.beyondsolo.notify.owned.hall.body: The east wing is yours: a tall hall with training dummies that take every blow and skill and show your damage a second.
home.beyondsolo.notify.owned.penthouse.b: The whole top of the tower is yours: a trophy hall for the great threats you slay, and a roof terrace over the city.
home.beyondsolo.notify.rooms.studio.body: Sleep in your bed for a night's rest: health, mana and fatigue come back, and once a day you wake Well Rested. The chests are yours to fill. The lift's button takes you back out.
home.beyondsolo.notify.rooms.family.body: The desk in the study opens the Association's office, and the bell beside it calls the gate broker, both for wherever you left the world. Once your mother is awake, she moves into her room.
home.beyondsolo.notify.rooms.hall.body: Hit the dummies with anything you have: they never fall, and show your damage a second over each bout. The armoured one takes blows like a well-armoured foe.
home.beyondsolo.notify.rooms.penthouse.b: Each pedestal of the trophy hall waits for a great threat. Slay one and its likeness stands there. Up the stairs, the terrace looks out over the city.
home.beyondsolo.notify.mother.body: Your mother has moved into her room in the Family Home. She's glad to be close to you.
home.beyondsolo.notify.rested.body: A good night in your own bed. You wake Well Rested for %s minutes.
home.beyondsolo.rested.again: You slept well. (Well Rested comes once a day.)

command.beyondsolo.solo.help.home.info: Shows how a player's home stands.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.home.give: Gives the players that part of a home for free (none takes their home away).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.home.go: Takes the player home at once: no standing still, no wait.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.home.visit: Takes the player into the host's home at once, party or not.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.home.leave: Takes the player back out into the world.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.home.build: Builds every home that is going up, now.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.home.rebuil: Builds the player's home (and the city round it) again from nothing.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.home.rest: Gives the players a night's rest now, Well Rested even if they had it today.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.home.ready: Clears the wait before the players can go home again.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.home.trophi: Counts every great threat of the trophy hall as slain that many times (0: none).
